name: Foremost
description: The Foremost was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire's naval forces. The Foremost joined other members of Admiral Carlou Gendling's task force, including the Thunder Wasp and two Raider-class corvettes during the battle over Umbara. Umbaran insurgents sent vulture droids to attack Gendling's squadron, including the Foremost.

data.name: Foremost
engine: Cygnus Spaceworks Gemon-4 ion engines (4) (emergency use)
